column3: The Cosmic Exploration Initiative has officially completed its operations in Sinus Ardorum!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Thanks to the hard work and diligence of contributors like you, we are ready to leap from our Lunar Hopopolis to frontiers unknown. 'Tis a dream come true!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>We hope you will join us as we continue to seek delightful new discoveries on distant stars.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Sincerely,<hex:02100103>The Loporrits

The Cosmic Exploration Initiative has officially completed its operations on Phaenna!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>The Phaenna Stellascope, a monument to the hard work of our countless contributors, now turns its glassy gaze to the sea of stars.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Its observations will no doubt propel us to yet more wonder and discovery, which we hope to share with you before long.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Sincerely,<hex:02100103>The Loporrits

The Cosmic Exploration Initiative has officially completed its operations on Oizys!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Thanks to the tireless efforts and dedication of our contributors, we have restored the Euhedron and obtained a wealth of invaluable information.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Our path forward is clear. Guided by the Voyagers, we sail ever deeper into the sea of stars─and we hope you will continue to accompany us in our search for answers.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Sincerely,<hex:02100103>The Loporrits
